name: button
title: Button
description: Product buttons and site pill buttons, with variants for primary, secondary, and contextual actions.
usage: Every action. In the product one `brand` (blue) per screen for the main action, `outline` (the default) for the rest, `primary` (black) to save, `ghost` for quiet actions, `on-brand` on a blue panel; `md` (40px, the default) for a form's or page's main action, `sm` (32px) in toolbars and cards. On the site one `pill` (black) per section, `pill-outline` for the rest, `pill-on-brand` on blue.
avoid: Two blue main actions on one product screen

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
